courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「需求介面與試驗追溯」與「整合模式與未知狀態」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Requirements, interfaces and test traceability" and "Integrated modes and unknown states" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Guideway precision control for maglev must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以需求追溯和交叉量測整合鐵路試驗證據；磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制則以以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rail integration evidence through requirements traceability and cross-measurement; Guideway precision control for maglev centres on maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「需求介面與試驗追溯」與「導向道測量角度誤差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Requirements, interfaces and test traceability” and “Angular error in guideway surveying”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Guideway precision control for maglev, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 台灣高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「需求介面與試驗追溯」與「整合模式與未知狀態」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台灣高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Requirements, interfaces and test traceability" and "Integrated modes and unknown states" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taiwan High Speed Rail must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以需求追溯和交叉量測整合鐵路試驗證據；台灣高速鐵路則以高速鐵路車軌橋與地震系統介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rail integration evidence through requirements traceability and cross-measurement; Taiwan High Speed Rail centres on high speed vehicle track bridge and seismic interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「需求介面與試驗追溯」與「延遲與制動距離」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台灣高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「再生煞車能量與受電條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Requirements, interfaces and test traceability” and “Delay and braking distance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taiwan High Speed Rail, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Regenerative energy and receptivity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路系統整合測試與試運轉
history.titleEn: Rail-system integration testing and trial running
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以需求追溯和交叉量測整合鐵路試驗證據而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用整合試驗工時與恢復及試運轉服務與缺陷修復連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For rail integration evidence through requirements traceability and cross-measurement, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through integration-test effort and restoration and trial service and defect recovery. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
